checks.name: fixed-bound-credential-fields
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_secrets import fields
x=fields({'binding':'a'*64,'access_token':'synthetic-access'})
assert isinstance(x,dict) and x=={'binding':'a'*64,'access_token':'synthetic-access'}, 'Must preserve only validated protected fields'

checks.name: canonical-reference-is-validated
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_secrets import reference
assert reference('11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111')=='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', 'Canonical opaque reference required'

checks.name: isolated-store-staging-and-recovery
checks.run:
import unittest
s=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.test_drive_secrets')
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(s)
assert r.wasSuccessful() and not r.skipped, 'Protected Drive staging and recovery must pass'
